tasks.label: 1. Preview the site
tasks.detail: Opens the curriculum in your browser and keeps it updated as you type. Leave it running.

tasks.label: 2. New module or phase
tasks.detail: Creates a new page (or a whole new section) with the right name, number and address filled in.

tasks.label: 3. Import a Word document
tasks.detail: Turns ONE Word file into ONE module: converts the writing, files its pictures, fills in the settings.

tasks.label: 4. Check before publishing
tasks.detail: Looks for mistakes and builds the whole site. Run this before you push.
